pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with sharply defined edge gradients and varying spatial scales; larger tessellated shapes on the mid-flank transition to smaller, more rounded geometries near the ventral and posterior margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological web with distinct tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; corridor width is narrow and maintains consistent pixel thickness relative to patch area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, creating a continuous jagged 1D geometric contour against the background.
